title: Existence of partial diagonal trace comparison data
statement: Under the hypotheses of the diagonal trace comparison presentation, there exists a PartialPresentation whose projective-line model is the specified isomorphism m.

source.place: paragraph (1), construction before the Milnor comparison

proof.text: Pull the unit l on S to X using f.appTop. Apply the one-scheme normalized Chern/twist construction separately at S and X. With these data apply the geometric-model lemma, retaining the specified equality of its model with m.

The constant-coefficient inverse image is exact and left adjoint to direct image. Its tower functor is exact too, so tower direct image preserves K-injectives; direct image preserves limits as a right adjoint. Apply the general diagonalDirectImage_of_preservesKInjective argument of the derived-limit node, which does not use the finite-field restrictions of the public geometric specialization. This supplies LX,LS,Rf,Rt and the common-unit-normalized LimitSquare.

Apply the scalar-comparison lemma to the constructed geometry and Rf,Rt. On a K-injective P the canonical cochain unit of g.push is the inverse of rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso P. Multiply the full varying-square normalization by the image of its hom and cancel hom followed by inv. The resulting equation is precisely varying_normalization. Assemble every field of PartialPresentation and use the geometric-model equality for the final conclusion.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1); explicit local Chern/model/scalar separation, derived-limit construction and unit cancellation

lean.statement: theorem exists_diagonalTraceComparisonPartial (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian S] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l X] [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l S] (f : X ⟶ S) (m : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hm : m.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f) (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(S, ⊤))) : ∃ p : PartialPresentation l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) f, p.model.model = m
